name: SEC Cross Country Championships
where: Columbia, MO · host Missouri · Gans Creek Cross Country Course
headline: SEC: Alabama, Arkansas and Florida put three top-10 men’s teams in one race
summary: No. 4 Alabama, No. 7 Arkansas and No. 9 Florida race for the men’s title at Gans Creek, and Alabama’s men and women were picked to win the league in the preseason coaches’ poll. No. 4 Florida women, last year’s champions, meet No. 9 Alabama.
